entry.title: Stores into a sub-object the destination reader used to misname are now refused: 1,450 statements in 173 functions (1,353 through a parenthesised base, 97 through a subscripted aggregate)
entry.why: Card W44-ASSIGNMENT-DESTINATION-SUFFIX-PLACE stops `direct_assignment_destination` from naming the first place-spelling suffix of a left-hand side (`recs[i].name` named `name`) and refuses every such store at the lexical indirect-access gate. Measured at the BEFORE census (docs/reports/w44-assignment-destination-suffix-place/census/): 1,450 distinct statements the old classifier had admitted under a misnamed destination (1,148 Alias, 295 Clear, 6 ForgetScalar, 1 ContractCall), in 173 functions (168 Unknown, 3 provisional Unsafe, 2 Safe: LZ4_write16 and LZ4_write32, which move to Unknown). 1,353 have a parenthesised base, which is macro-expanded C: `(rkbuf)->rkbuf_err = E`, `((LZ4_unalign *) p)->u16 = v`, `(&s)->str = NULL`, `(*map)->opts = calloc(...)`. 97 have a subscripted aggregate: `result[index].label = NULL`, `opt[pos].mlen = 1`. The typed routes consulted after the refusal admit none of them. DISCHARGE: a card that lowers these as the store they are, with Lean parity and a measured re-pin. One way is to read `( NAME ) -> f` as the whole place `NAME->f`, a typed store through a cast or `&` base, and a typed `a[i].f` scalar store. No such store may bind any name but its real destination.

ground: Its discharge condition: "a card that lowers these as the store they are, with Lean parity and a measured re-pin ... No such store may bind any name but its real destination." Card W45-SUB-OBJECT-STORES lowers a refused sub-object store (`R->F`, `(R)->F`, `R[I].F`, `S.F`, `(&S)->F`, a local `A[I].F`) as `LegacyInstruction::SubObjectStore`, the store it is: it writes the member's place and no name, and every flow premise that fails falls back to the gate's refusal byte for byte (Lean QCore.SubObjectStore, audited by AuditSubObjectStore.lean). Measured re-pin: 1,054 sub-object stores lowered, 223 gate leaves removed, destroy_id Unknown -> Safe, leak 37 and every violation leaf unchanged (docs/reports/w45-sub-object-stores/README.md). The shapes that stay refused are re-registered narrower with their AFTER-census sizes: W45-SUB-OBJECT-STORE-MEMBER-UNRESOLVED (the `(rkbuf)->rkbuf_err` family), W45-SUB-OBJECT-STORE-CHAIN, W45-SUB-OBJECT-STORE-ROOT-UNRESOLVED, W45-SUB-OBJECT-STORE-FORMAL-VALUE, W45-SUB-OBJECT-STORE-OWNED-VALUE, W45-SUB-OBJECT-STORE-VALUE-SHAPES and W45-SUB-OBJECT-STORE-PREFIX (casts and `(*p)`).
